answer_1.quote: our work focuses on the unified generation of QADs.
answer_1.outputs: Generated Questions, Answers, and Distractors (QADs) for multiple-choice Visual Question Answering.

answer_2.quote: Metrics. We employ BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, and CIDEr with ground-truth QADs to evaluate the quality of the generated QADs.

answer_4.quote: To further assess the effectiveness of ReBo, we conducted a human evaluation of 300 images. We recruit six annotators to rate them from 1 to 5 points on five qualitative aspects: (1) Quality The overall quality of the generated QADs includes question relevance, answer accuracy, and the confusion level of distractors. (2) Intersection The intersection score represents whether the semantic contents of generated QADs for a given image are dissimilar. (3) Union The union score represents whether the generated QADs can summarize the overall content of the image.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated the generated QADs on a scale of 1 to 5 for five aspects: Quality (including sub-scores for questions, answers, distractors), Intersection, and Union.
